scope: Toy-preset ray families against independent references: pole and core crossings in one ray; equatorial grazes of both shell joins; prograde rays at the buried Kerr photon orbit, with Kerr contrast. Sampled fixtures, not a certificate for arbitrary rays; grazes shallower than the stated depth are reported, not classified; no GYOTO comparison.
